description: This file defines the 'Image_Graph_Logo' class, which is responsible for rendering a logo image on a graphical canvas within the Image_Graph package. It includes methods for setting image properties and outputting the logo at specified positions.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Logo
classes.description: A class to display a logo image on a canvas, with configurable alignment.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Logo
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the logo with a filename and optional alignment.

methods.name: _setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent element and configures the coordinate boundaries.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the logo image on the canvas at the specified alignment and position.
